one_liner: Enterprise CRM platform with extensive multi-cloud APIs and customizable object metadata.
auth_notes: OAuth2 via Connected App or External Client App; JWT bearer flow for server-to-server; access token in Authorization header.
credential_path: Sign up for free Developer Edition org, create Connected/External Client App in Setup, enable OAuth scopes, copy client id/secret.
breadth_note: REST, SOAP, Bulk, Metadata and GraphQL APIs across hundreds of standard plus custom sObjects.

mcp.note: Salesforce-hosted MCP servers documented as GA for Enterprise Edition and above; salesforcecli/mcp also exists for dev tooling.

rate_limits: Daily org API request limits by edition/licenses; concurrent request caps.
notes: Free Developer Edition has API on. Customer Group/Professional orgs need a paid API add-on. AppExchange listing requires ISV security review.

one_liner: Inbound marketing, sales and service CRM with broad public REST APIs.
auth_notes: Private app access token (bearer) for single-account use; OAuth2 for multi-account or marketplace apps. Legacy static API keys retired.
credential_path: Create free HubSpot account, Settings > Integrations > Private Apps, pick scopes, copy token; or register developer app for OAuth.
breadth_note: CRM objects, marketing, CMS, conversations, automation; hundreds of endpoints plus associations and custom objects.

mcp.note: Two official servers: remote CRM MCP at mcp.hubspot.com (OAuth) and a local developer MCP for app/CMS building.

rate_limits: 100 req/10s for OAuth apps, 500 req/10s for private apps; daily caps.
notes: Listing a public app on the HubSpot App Marketplace requires app review; private/OAuth apps for own use do not. Some objects need paid tiers.

one_liner: Sales-pipeline-focused CRM with a mature versioned REST API.
auth_notes: Personal API token for own-account scripts; OAuth2 client id/secret from Developer Hub with scoped consent for multi-tenant apps.
credential_path: Start free trial, Personal preferences > API to copy token; or register an app in Pipedrive Developer Hub for OAuth credentials.
breadth_note: v1 and v2 REST across deals, persons, organizations, activities, products; published OpenAPI 3 specs and SDKs.

mcp.note: Native Pipedrive-built MCP server launched June 2026, reported available on all Pipedrive plans.

rate_limits: Token-budget per 2-second window; 10,000 POST/PUT per user daily.
notes: API access reported on every plan, but there is no permanent free tier so a trial or paid seat is needed. Marketplace listing needs Pipedrive review.

one_liner: Modern flexible-data-model CRM with a clean, well-documented REST API.
auth_notes: Workspace API key used as Bearer token, or per-user OAuth2 authorization-code access token; both use the same Bearer scheme.
credential_path: Create Attio workspace, Workspace Settings > Developers, create an integration and API key with scopes; OAuth app for distribution.
breadth_note: REST over objects, records, lists, entries, notes, tasks, comments and webhooks; attribute schema is workspace-defined.

mcp.note: Official remote MCP with OAuth login and dynamic client registration; docs at docs.attio.com/mcp/overview. Some SQL tools are plan-gated.

rate_limits: 100 read req/s, 25 write req/s; 429 with Retry-After header.
notes: One third-party blog claimed API access needs approval and 1,000 calls/hour; official docs show self-serve keys, so that claim is treated as unreliable.

one_liner: Open-source, self-hostable CRM with auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs.
auth_notes: Workspace API key sent as Bearer token; created in Settings > API & Webhooks and optionally scoped to a role.
credential_path: Self-host from GitHub or sign up for Twenty Cloud, then Settings > API & Webhooks > Create key and copy it once.
breadth_note: Core CRUD at /rest and /graphql plus metadata API at /rest/metadata; endpoints follow each workspace's own schema.

mcp.note: Several community MCP servers exist; an official one was still an open feature request (twentyhq/twenty issue 12953). Some blogs claim a native Cloud MCP — unverified.

blocker: Schema is per-workspace with no static API reference, so the tool surface must be generated at runtime.
notes: Unconfirmed: official MCP status and rate limits. Self-hosted instances have no vendor-enforced limits; Cloud limits not found in docs.

one_liner: Progress-owned low-code work and CRM platform built on configurable apps.
auth_notes: OAuth2 only against api.podio.com: server-side flow, app authentication (app id + app token), or username/password flow.
credential_path: Create Podio account, register an API client in account settings to get client_id and client_secret, then run an OAuth flow.
breadth_note: Large REST surface: items, apps, orgs, spaces, tasks, files, comments, hooks, views and more.

mcp.note: Official Podio MCP server documented at mcp.podio.com in Progress/ShareFile docs; read and write over workspaces, apps and items.

rate_limits: Hourly per-client limit; third-party cites 250/hour, not verified officially.
notes: Unconfirmed: exact rate-limit numbers. Product moved from Citrix to Progress Software and is actively maintained, not sunset.

one_liner: Zoho suite CRM with a v8 REST API and credit-based rate limiting.
auth_notes: OAuth2 only; Self Client grant for server-to-server, authorization code for user apps. Access tokens last one hour, refresh tokens persist.
credential_path: Register a client (Self Client or Server-based) in Zoho API Console, pick scopes, generate auth code, exchange for refresh token.
breadth_note: Records, modules, COQL queries, bulk read/write, metadata, notifications; datacenter-specific domains (.com/.eu/.in).

mcp.note: Zoho runs mcp.zoho.com with prebuilt CRM servers (Data Insights, Data Operations, Module Customization, Workflow Automation). Exact doc URL unverified.

rate_limits: Credit-based daily limits by edition (Free 5,000/day); concurrency 5-25 calls.
notes: Free edition confirmed to have API credits. Multi-datacenter token/domain handling adds integration complexity. Zoho MCP docs URL not directly retrieved.

one_liner: Inside-sales CRM with built-in calling, email and a REST API.
auth_notes: API key sent via HTTP Basic (key as username, empty password); OAuth2 client id/secret yields a Bearer access token.
credential_path: Start a Close trial, Settings > API Keys > generate key; or register an OAuth app in Close developer settings for client id/secret.
breadth_note: Leads, contacts, opportunities, activities (calls, emails, SMS), custom fields, smart views, reporting.

mcp.note: Official remote MCP at mcp.close.com/mcp with streamable HTTP and OAuth2 dynamic client registration.

rate_limits: Per-endpoint-group limits via RateLimit headers; org limit 3x key limit.
notes: Close publishes no fixed numeric rate limit; limits are per endpoint group and exposed in headers. No free plan, so trial or paid seat needed.

one_liner: Google Workspace-native CRM with a header-key REST API.
auth_notes: API key via X-PW-AccessToken plus X-PW-UserEmail headers. OAuth2 client credentials are only issued after contacting partners@copper.com.
credential_path: For keys: System Settings > API Keys > Generate API Key in the Copper app. For OAuth: email partners@copper.com to register an app.
breadth_note: REST v1 for people, companies, opportunities, leads, tasks, activities, projects and webhook subscriptions.

mcp.note: No official Copper MCP found; several community and aggregator-hosted servers (Apideck, Pipedream, n8n, viaSocket) exist.

rate_limits: Third-party sources cite ~600 req/min per key; official figure unconfirmed.
blocker: OAuth client credentials require Copper partner approval; only per-user API keys are self-serve.
notes: OAuth explicitly requires registering with Copper's partner team, so multi-tenant toolkits need outreach; API-key-only single-tenant builds work today.

one_liner: Intapp's deal and relationship CRM for private capital and advisory firms.
auth_notes: OAuth2 client-credentials bearer token; the client id/secret come from an API key generated in the user profile after admin enablement.
credential_path: Admin enables API under Admin > User Management > Capabilities > Site Areas, then user Profile > API Key > Enable and copy.
breadth_note: Data, schema, user management, RelIntel, publications and eMarketing endpoints over a tenant-configured schema.

mcp.note: DealCloud MCP server documented, reported as client preview from July 2026; responses scoped to requesting user's permissions.

rate_limits: 5 req/s data, schema, user mgmt; 300/min auth; 1000/s eMarketing.
blocker: Requires a licensed DealCloud tenant plus admin-granted API capability; no public sandbox or self-signup found.
notes: Docs are public but credentials are gated behind a paid tenant and an admin. Webhook/event-notification support not confirmed in retrieved docs.
